<style>
/* Instant Quote — embed-only CSS (page head) */

:root {
  --iq-bg: #00001c;
  --iq-border: #ffffff;
  --iq-tick-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  --iq-tick-mark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

.iq-slider-control {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 11px;
}

.iq-slider-ticks {
  position: absolute;
  left: 11px;
  right: 11px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  height: 12px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.iq-slider-track-line {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--iq-tick-line);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 0;
}

.iq-slider-tick {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 1px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-tick-mark);
  flex: 0 0 1px;
}

.iq-range {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-range:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.iq-range:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.iq-range:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.iq-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.iq-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 44px;
  margin-top: -21px;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.iq-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  transform: scaleY(1.04);
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-track {
  height: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 22px;
  height: 44px;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-progress {
  background: transparent;
}

.iq-toggle-track .iq-toggle-btn {
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-wrap: nowrap;
}

.iq-check {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  min-width: 22px;
  min-height: 22px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.iq-style-option .iq-check {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  min-width: 20px;
  min-height: 20px;
}

.iq-check:checked {
  background: var(--iq-border);
}

.iq-check:checked::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 5px;
  height: 9px;
  border: solid var(--iq-bg);
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: translate(-50%, -58%) rotate(45deg);
}

#split-row-wrapper {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  transition:
    max-height 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.36s ease,
    transform 0.36s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  visibility: hidden;
}

#split-row-wrapper.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
  visibility: visible;
}

#iq-unit-cost-2 {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  transition:
    max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  visibility: hidden;
}

#iq-unit-cost-2.is-visible {
  max-height: 96px;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
  visibility: visible;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* ── Slider rows — aligned label | track | value ───────────────────── */

.iq-sliders-block {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 18px;
  width: 100%;
}

.iq-slider-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr 72px;
  column-gap: 32px;
  align-items: center;
  width: 100%;
}

.iq-slider-label,
.iq-slider-value {
  margin: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.iq-slider-value {
  min-height: 48px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ── Apparel style grid: 4 cols × 2 rows (original mockup) ───────── */

.iq-style-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px 12px;
  width: fit-content;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  justify-self: center;
}

/* Center 2×4 grid in apparel row middle column (row 1 + split row) */
.iq-apparel-row:not(.iq-artwork-row) > .iq-style-grid,
#iq-style-row-1,
#iq-style-row-2 {
  justify-self: center;
}

/* ── Total cost receipt ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-receipt {
  padding-bottom: 100px;
}

.iq-total-wrapper {
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 32px 28px 40px;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.iq-total-price {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

/* ── Artwork row (matches Apparel Style label column) ──────────────── */

.iq-artwork-row,
[id='iq-artwork-row'] {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr;
  gap: 32px;
  width: 100%;
  align-items: stretch;
}

.iq-artwork-label-box,
[id='iq-artwork-row'] > .iq-apparel-label-box {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 120px;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 18px 12px 14px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#iq-unit-price-col:has(#iq-unit-cost-2.is-visible) {
  padding-bottom: 24px;
}

[id='iq-artwork-row'] > div:last-child {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 120px;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 18px 16px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.iq-apparel-label-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.iq-artwork-label-fill {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 56px;
}

.iq-artwork-panel .iq-form-upload,
.iq-artwork-panel [id='iq-form-artwork-drop'] {
  flex: 1;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
}

/* Per-unit price — right column of apparel row (mock-up) */
#iq-unit-price-col,
.iq-unit-cost-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 10px;
  align-self: start;
  grid-column: 3;
  width: 100%;
}

#iq-unit-price-col.is-split-visible {
  padding-bottom: 24px;
}

#iq-unit-cost-1,
#iq-unit-cost-2 {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 12px 10px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background: transparent;
}

.iq-unit-cost-label {
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  display: block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.2;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.iq-price-box {
  margin: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 0;
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.2vw, 28px);
  font-weight: 700;
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1.1;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.iq-receipt-left {
  display: none !important;
}

.iq-receipt {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
}

/* Extra padding before Artwork Files row */
#iq-artwork-row {
  margin-top: 40px;
}

.iq-artwork-info-link,
#iq-artwork-info-trigger {
  appearance: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.iq-artwork-info-link:hover,
.iq-artwork-info-link:focus-visible,
#iq-artwork-info-trigger:hover,
#iq-artwork-info-trigger:focus-visible {
  color: var(--iq-border);
  outline: none;
}

.iq-artwork-info-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── Order form ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-order-section {
  width: 100%;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  padding-top: 8px;
}

.iq-order-heading {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 40px);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.iq-order-lead {
  margin: 0 0 28px;
  max-width: 760px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.iq-form {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 28px;
}

.iq-form-fieldset {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  min-width: 0;
}

.iq-form-legend {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.iq-form-hint {
  margin: -6px 0 14px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.iq-form-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.iq-form-grid--2 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

/* Native Webflow form — contact 2×2 (label above input per column) */
#iq-order-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  column-gap: 24px;
  row-gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}

#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(6) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 4; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(7) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(8) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 4; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(9) { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 5; margin-top: 8px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(10) { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 6; margin-bottom: 16px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(11) { display: none; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(12) { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 7; margin-top: 8px; }

#iq-order-form .w-form-label,
#iq-order-form label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

#iq-order-form .w-input,
#iq-order-form .w-select,
#iq-order-form input[type='text'],
#iq-order-form input[type='email'],
#iq-order-form input[type='tel'],
#iq-order-form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#iq-order-form .w-input:focus,
#iq-order-form textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.45);
}

.iq-form-grid--3 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.iq-form-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.iq-form-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
}

.iq-form-required {
  color: var(--iq-border);
}

.iq-form-quote-hidden {
  display: none;
}

.iq-form-input,
.iq-form-textarea,
.iq-form-output {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.iq-form-input:focus,
.iq-form-textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.45);
}

.iq-form-textarea {
  resize: vertical;
  min-height: 132px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.iq-form-field--readonly .iq-form-output {
  min-height: 52px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.iq-form-output--total {
  font-size: 24px;
}

.iq-form-upload {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}

.iq-form-upload.is-dragover {
  border-color: #2aaab8;
  background: rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.08);
}

.iq-form-upload-input {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 2;
}

.iq-form-artwork-input-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.iq-form-upload-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  padding: 34px 24px;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.iq-form-upload-title {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.iq-form-upload-hint {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.iq-form-upload-btn {
  pointer-events: auto;
  appearance: none;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-form-upload-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.iq-form-upload-list li {
  padding: 8px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  font-size: 14px;
}

.iq-form-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
}

/* Homepage hero CTA — gradient ring + navy fill on hover */
@keyframes ltf-nebula-gradient-shift {
  0%   { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50%  { background-position: 100% 50%; }
  100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

.iq-form-cta-wrap,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: transparent;
  transition: box-shadow 0.35s ease;
}

.iq-form-cta-wrap:hover,
.iq-form-cta-wrap:focus-within,
.iq-form-cta-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:focus-within,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active {
  background: linear-gradient(45deg, #4D259D, #2AAAB8, #1F7781, #0B8050, #7040C0, #4D259D);
  background-size: 200% 200%;
  animation: ltf-nebula-gradient-shift 3s linear infinite;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 16px rgba(77, 37, 157, 0.45),
    0 0 28px rgba(31, 119, 129, 0.28);
}

.iq-form-submit,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-primary.is-hero-cta {
  appearance: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  padding: 16px 34px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease;
}

.iq-form-cta-wrap:hover .iq-form-submit,
.iq-form-cta-wrap:focus-within .iq-form-submit,
.iq-form-cta-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active .iq-form-submit,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover .ltf-btn-primary.is-hero-cta,
.iq-order-section .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active .ltf-btn-primary.is-hero-cta {
  background: #06142E;
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
}

.iq-form-submit:disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.iq-form-status {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 1.4em;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}

.iq-form-status.is-success {
  color: #6ee7b7;
}

.iq-form-status.is-error {
  color: #fca5a5;
}

/* ── Artwork info modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, visibility 0.25s ease;
}

.iq-modal.is-open {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.iq-modal-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 28, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.iq-modal-panel {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(560px, 100%);
  max-height: min(80vh, 640px);
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--iq-bg);
  padding: 28px 28px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

.iq-modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-modal-title {
  margin: 0 32px 16px 0;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.iq-modal-body p {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.iq-modal-body p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── Pricing breakdown (3 columns) ───────────────────────────────────── */

#iq-pricing-breakdown,
.iq-breakdown {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 28px;
  width: 100%;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  padding-top: 48px;
  padding-bottom: 24px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#iq-pricing-breakdown > div,
.iq-breakdown-col {
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 28px 24px 32px;
  background: transparent;
  min-height: 260px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#iq-pricing-breakdown h3,
.iq-breakdown-heading {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  font-size: clamp(22px, 2.4vw, 28px);

      totalSetupCost: totalSetupCost,

    var toggle = document.getElementById('iq-custom-art-toggle');
    if (!toggle) return;
    toggle.addEventListener('change', recalculateQuote);
  }

  function init() {
    initSliders();
    initSplitToggle();
    initQualityToggle();
    initStyleRadios();
    initCustomArtToggle();
    recalculateQuote();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
